Chapter 1211 - 25 Invincible Great Saint? (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1211: Chapter 25 Invincible Great Saint? (Request Subscription)

The girl in red looked around, trying to capture the source of oppression, but felt the vastness of the world beyond her gaze.

"Infinite Void" has been inherited for endless ages, experienced by successive cultivators, with some even cultivating it to the fifth layer, reaching the power to overlook the entire Chaos Void as an Invincible Great Saint.

The girl in red was well aware of the pressure of an Invincible Great Saint, but compared to this moment, it still seemed slightly inferior.

"What is going on?"

The girl in red kept observing, her thoughts spreading, and her first thought was whether Lin Yuan had become an Invincible Great Saint?

But she immediately dismissed it, first because Lin Yuan wasn’t even in the Chaos Realm, so how could he talk of being an Invincible Great Saint?

Secondly, the internal universe she sensed had not undergone more intricate microscopic restructuring.

It was evident that the third layer of "Infinite Void" was not yet accomplished.

In this situation, the girl in red was curious about what means Lin Yuan used to produce a transformation that even made her feel oppressively transformed?

Did he master the second thirteenth-grade inheritance?

Mastery here is not an entry point, but like "Infinite Void," at least trained to the fifth layer.

But this is equally as difficult as ascending to the heavens, a thirteenth-grade inheritance is not a roadside cabbage, easily mastered; each thirteenth-grade inheritance has numerous preconditions.

This point is evident from how many years Lin Yuan has cultivated "Infinite Void," still remaining at the second layer.

Moreover, the girl in red faintly felt that the oppression she captured at this moment was definitely not due to the power transformation from mastering some inheritance.

This pressure is related to the transformation of life’s essence or the compensation of one’s Dao, like the ultimate leap of an eleventh-grade life into the twelfth grade, or the utmost sublimation of one’s Dao, etc.

...

The giant egg composed of Chaos Rule veins was momentarily crumbling, and a large amount of intertwined black and white power overflowed, converging before Lin Yuan.

"Is this... the chaotic power path that I have evolved?"

Lin Yuan gazed at the black and white forces before him, feeling both familiar and strange.

This was an entirely new rule of power he’d never mastered, yet Lin Yuan had an illusion of having it innately.

A large amount of black and white power continuously intertwined and fused, each thread of black and white power contained the vast rule essence Lin Yuan mastered, and finally, as the Chaos Giant Egg completely shattered, all the black and white power finally converged, forming a black and white crossed Tai Chi Diagram.

The white part contained endless Taiyang power, supremely rigid and Yang.

The black part was circulating with the perpetual flow of Taiyin power, grand and vast.

The balance between Taiyin and Taiyang power formed a perfect equilibrium, fusing and differentiating at every moment.

"Boom～～～"

Lin Yuan looked at the Tai Chi Diagram before him, feeling his consciousness was roaring; in the moment the Tai Chi Diagram took shape, a miniature Taiji Diagram imprint appeared on Lin Yuan’s brow.

Not only this cosmic embodiment within but the true self outside, and the Primordial Spirit embodiments throughout the Chaos Void, all gathered a Taiji Diagram imprint at the brow.

"Chaos Taiji?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze became unprecedentedly distant and profound; the black and white intersecting Tai Chi Diagram before his eyes instantly expanded countless times, merging with his entire internal universe.

Lin Yuan’s internal universe was measured by trillions of light-years, yet the expansion and complete coverage of the Tai Chi Diagram took no more than an instant, just Lin Yuan’s mere thought, and the Tai Chi Diagram had already completed its fusion.

Instant arrival upon thought.

The moment the boundless Tai Chi Diagram merged with the internal universe, the internal universe began to undergo some transformation; space-time was becoming increasingly perfect, the Dao rules were rapidly being enhanced, and the size of the internal universe started to expand crazily.

Why is the evolution of the Chaos Power Path within the Chaos Void termed a Great Saint if not a Venerable?

Because the power of a Chaos Great Saint far surpasses that of a Chaos Venerable, this supremacy is all-encompassing, deriving from the evolved Chaos Power Path.

The Chaos Great Saint, who evolves the Chaos Power Path, will be nourished by the Chaos Power Path in every aspect; their physical body, soul, spirit, will, and internal universe will all receive a massive uplift.

At this moment, although Lin Yuan is not perfectly in the Chaos Realm, the Chaotic Taiji Dao has been smoothly evolved, naturally bringing about a comprehensive transformation and uplift to himself.

...

The changes in the internal universe were immediately perceived by the girl in red.

"This change?"

The heart of the girl in red was shaken.

The change in the internal universe at this moment was not the kind of transformation practiced by "Infinite Void."

"Infinite Void" essentially involves the reorganization of the most microscopic parts of the internal universe, similar to carbon turning into a diamond, the particle compositions of both remain the same.

But the transformation of the internal universe at hand is the most direct degree of transformation, from one to two to a hundred to a thousand to ten thousand.

Everything is sublimating and transforming, as if ascending with the rising sun into the sky.

"Chaos Evolution Power Path, has the Chaos Evolution Power Path been realized?"

At this moment, the girl in red finally speculated on key information; the means to cause the internal universe to undergo such a change are not many, especially such a dramatic transformation in a short time, only a few, such as entering the Chaos Realm or evolving a Chaos Power Path.

"Exactly what kind of Chaos Power Path was evolved to cause such a commotion?"

The girl in red took a deep breath, she was very aware of Lin Yuan’s talent and aptitude, and did not doubt the new master evolving the Chaos Power Path.

But now?

The magnitude of the internal universe’s uplift, and the immense pressure she felt, caused her perception to question.
